scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@unitrack/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@unitrack/internal-auth
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others --names web,users,equipment,loans "npm run dev --workspace=@unitrack/web -- --port 3000" "npm run dev --workspace=@unitrack/users" "npm run dev --workspace=@unitrack/equipment" "npm run dev --workspace=@unitrack/loans"
